comparison.objective: Align mating flanges and insert locating pins through their holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual part registration, sustained flange support, multi-hole alignment, and precision pin insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Flanges within specified position/orientation tolerances and pins seated in distinct aligned holes; versions cover four vertical pins or two horizontal pins.
comparison.reason: This tests assembly by alignment and insertion, not impact fracture or extraction. No material must break, no retained coil must survive lateral impulse, and no released debris must be found and contained.
